# motion-dev-animations — 199-biotechnologies

**Repo:** https://github.com/199-biotechnologies/motion-dev-animations-skill · **Upstream standalone install (optional):** `npx skills add 199-biotechnologies/motion-dev-animations-skill`
**In the set:** 1 tool — `motion-dev-animations` (264 lines, v3.0.0; `allowed-tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Glob, Grep`).

## What it is

Motion.dev (the Framer Motion successor) for React, Next.js, Svelte and Astro: 120fps
GPU-accelerated patterns, gestures, scroll and parallax, layout animations, spring physics.

## The contract

Framework-specific — only when the project is on Motion.dev / Framer Motion. It is a technique,
not routed; the taste decision comes first.
